name: Scalable Capital MCP
description: Checks portfolios, quotes and transactions and places reviewed trades and savings plans in a Scalable Capital brokerage account from ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or the Scalable CLI.

skills.name: Portfolio Overview
skills.description: Retrieves the account profile, portfolio snapshots, holdings, cash and buying power, and transaction history for personal Broker accounts.

skills.name: Market Data
skills.description: Searches securities and derivatives and returns the latest quotes, chart data and security news in English or German.

skills.name: Reviewed Orders
skills.description: Prepares buy and sell order previews with costs and disclosures, then submits an order only after your fresh, explicit confirmation.

skills.name: Savings Plans
skills.description: Lists, previews, creates, updates and removes eligible savings plans, with a mandatory preview and explicit confirmation before submission.

skills.name: Watchlists and Price Alerts
skills.description: Adds and removes watchlist items and creates or removes security and crypto price alerts, at the Limited or Full access level.
